title: Composed supervisory control: Lead-lag pump demand control -> Fair two-client resource arbiter with emergency lockout

inputs.name: A_LowDemand
inputs.description: Subsystem A: At least one pump is required

inputs.name: A_HighDemand
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Both pumps are requested

inputs.name: A_LeadIsPump1
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Pump 1 is selected lead

inputs.name: B_RequestA
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Client A requests the resource

inputs.name: B_RequestB
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Client B requests the resource

inputs.name: B_Done
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Current client releases the resource

outputs.name: A_CapacityShortfall
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Requested capacity cannot be supplied

outputs.name: B_GrantA
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Resource grant to client A

outputs.name: B_GrantB
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Resource grant to client B

outputs.name: B_Busy
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Resource has an active owner

outputs.name: B_Turn
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Tie-break preference: 1 A, 2 B

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: With A_LowDemand only, the available selected lead pump shall run and the lag pump shall remain off.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: With A_HighDemand, every available pump shall run.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: If the selected lead is unavailable under A_LowDemand, the available lag pump shall run.
requirements.property: G((A_LowDemand AND !A_HighDemand AND !lead_available AND lag_available) -> lag_runs)

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: No pump shall run when neither demand input is TRUE.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_CapacityShortfall shall indicate zero available pumps for A_LowDemand or fewer than two for A_HighDemand.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_GrantA and B_GrantB shall never be TRUE simultaneously.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: When idle, a single request shall receive the resource; simultaneous requests shall follow B_Turn.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Done shall release the current grant before a new owner is selected on a later scan.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: After A completes B_Turn shall prefer B, and after B completes B_Turn shall prefer A.
requirements.property: G((B_Done AND B_GrantA)->X(B_Turn=2)) AND G((B_Done AND B_GrantB)->X(B_Turn=1))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Emergency shall immediately revoke all grants and latch B_LockedOut.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset shall clear B_LockedOut only while B_Emergency and both requests are FALSE.
A TRUE A_Pump1Run shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
